text:
Camila: Hey y'all — quick life update: I got promoted to Senior PM 🎉 and we closed on a new place in Portland this morning 🏡
Jasper: WHAAAT!! Huge congrats Camila!! :partying_face:
Priya: omg congrats!!! When's the move? we need a celebration (and a housewarming) 🎈
Camila: Moving end of April. Would love a potluck + tiny desk plant shower. Also, will need help with heavy lifting if anyone's local-ish 🙏
Hayden: I can help with moving day if it's a weekend — I have a truck :truck:
Marta: Congrats!! Cupcakes on me. Also can bring packing tape and snacks.
Oli: Congrats on the promo, thoroughly earned. Also Portland?? Nice!
Camila: Thank you all!! Feeling a bit emotional. Also, small ask: do folks prefer cupcakes or savory for the celebration? Vote below.
lunch-bot: Poll created: "Camila party snacks" — Options: Cupcakes, Savory, Both — ends in 3 days
Jasper: both obviously. Cupcakes are mandatory though.
Priya: +1 both. And can we do a card for your team to sign? I can organize a digital one.
Camila: Love that. Digital card would be perfect — thanks Priya.
Hayden: If anyone wants to chip in for a plant, I'll grab one from the nursery near my place.
Marta: I voted savory (for balance). Also sending :confetti_ball:
Oli: Adding a tiny congratulations GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-woo
Camila: 🤗 thank you all. Means a lot. Also note: promo celebration = first round of cupcakes on me at the office day after I move in (exact date TBD).
Jasper: This thread made my day. Congrats again, Camila!! :tada:
Priya: ❤️
lunch-bot: Poll ended: Both (42%), Cupcakes (35%), Savory (23%).
Camila: Both it is. I'll post details once dates are set. Also tagging @people-ops about a small team announcement so it can be added to next all-hands.
Marta: I'll bring my famous spinach dip.
Oli: Count me in for lifting day too.
Camila: You're the best. Thank you everyone — see you at the cupcakes party soon! :sparkles:
